voices.name: Kabir R – Firm yet Respectful Recovery
voices.description: Kabir R operates right at the edge of firm — professional enough to stay compliant, assertive enough to get results. His pressure-driven hinglish delivery selects the most assertive approach for resistant borrowers — pushing hard without crossing the line. Built for tough collections outreach, maximum pressure recovery, and high-resistance account follow-ups across banks, NBFCs, collection agencies, and fintech lenders that need a voice that means business.

voices.name: Kabira - The Meditator
voices.description: This is a peaceful meditation voice meant to calm you down and relax. It can be used for long meditation sessions.

voices.name: Kabir - Polite, Calm and Reassuring
voices.description:
A polite, confident Hindi voice designed for smooth and relatable customer support experiences.

Kabir R’s tone is calm, courteous, and reassuring—ideal for IVR systems, chatbots, AI agents, and voice assistants in sectors like banking, telecom, insurance, and e-commerce. His natural Hindi delivery builds trust and makes users feel heard, making him perfect for platforms serving Hindi-speaking audiences across mobile apps, helplines, and support portals.

voices.name: Kabir - Serious, Calm and Raspy
voices.description: This voice has an intense grain and an air of mystery, perfectly suited for suspenseful and gripping storytelling. Its measured pace and dramatic modulation keep listeners on edge, drawing them into every twist and turn of the narrative with chilling precision.

voices.name: Abir- Arabic Female

voices.name: Kadir C. - Street Philosopher
voices.description: Für die Momente nach Mitternacht. Ein tiefer, sanfter, aber gefährlich klingender Bariton. Perfekt für atmosphärische Vlogs, Late-Night-Gedanken oder stylische Street-Edits. Klingt nach teurem Parfüm und harten Straßen – die ultimative Stimme für ästhetischen Urban-Content.

voices.name: Kadir Kayışcı - Deep, Mature and Soft
voices.description: A mature, reassuring and expressive voice. Ideal for news, documentaries, storytelling and commercials. With clear articulation and a strong expressive style, it establishes authority over the listener, while at the same time offering a warm and fluid narration. A versatile voice that can adapt to formal and intimate projects.

voices.name: Kadir - Warm, Hopeful and Inviting
voices.description: My tone of voice is quite calm and natural. My style of expression is fluent and peaceful. Therefore, you can describe my voice character as 'calm, natural and fluent tone.
